tasks.name: Test Code Submission and Evaluation
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure code submission and evaluation works correctly.

tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure user profiles and progress tracking are accurate.

T1.implementation_approach: Design a user-friendly interface for browsing, filtering, and searching problems using modern UI frameworks like React or Angular.
T1.notes: Ensure responsive design for compatibility across devices.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to handle problem data retrieval, filtering, and search using a framework like Node.js or Django.
T2.notes: Focus on efficient query handling for large datasets.

T3.implementation_approach: Set up a relational database (e.g., PostgreSQL) to store problem details, tags, and metadata.
T3.notes: Ensure proper indexing for fast query performance.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a submission interface allowing users to upload code and view results using a clean and intuitive design.
T4.notes: Include real-time feedback for submission status.

T5.implementation_approach: Develop a system to evaluate code submissions using containerized environments like Docker for security and scalability.
T5.notes: Implement support for multiple programming languages.

T6.implementation_approach: Design a profile UI displaying user details, progress, and achievements using a visually appealing layout.
T6.notes: Include customization options for user profiles.

T7.implementation_approach: Build backend APIs to manage user data, progress tracking, and achievements using secure authentication mechanisms.
T7.notes: Ensure data privacy and encryption for sensitive information.

T8.implementation_approach: Set up a database to store user information, progress, and activity logs using a scalable schema.
T8.notes: Optimize for frequent read and write operations.

T9.implementation_approach: Develop a leaderboard UI to display rankings based on user performance and activity using dynamic sorting and filtering.
T9.notes: Ensure real-time updates for leaderboard changes.

T10.implementation_approach: Implement backend logic to calculate and update leaderboard rankings based on user submissions and scores.
T10.notes: Optimize for high concurrency during peak usage.

T11.implementation_approach: Design a UI to display hints and explanations for problems in an accessible and organized manner.
T11.notes: Allow users to unlock hints progressively to avoid spoilers.

T12.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage hints and explanations, including retrieval and access control.
T12.notes: Ensure hints are tied to specific problem IDs for accuracy.

T13.implementation_approach: Test the problem library for functionality, including search, filtering, and data retrieval.
T13.notes: Use automated and manual testing methods.

T14.implementation_approach: Test the code submission and evaluation system for accuracy, security, and performance under load.
T14.notes: Simulate various edge cases and invalid inputs.

T15.implementation_approach: Verify user profile features like progress tracking, achievements, and data updates through comprehensive testing.

T16.implementation_approach: Test leaderboard functionality for real-time updates, sorting, and filtering under different scenarios.
T16.notes: Check for concurrency issues during updates.

T17.implementation_approach: Test hints and explanations for proper display, access control, and relevance to problems.
T17.notes: Ensure hints unlock correctly based on user actions.

T18.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform on a cloud service like AWS or Azure, ensuring scalability and security configurations.
T18.notes: Perform final checks for performance and reliability before launch.
